## Population and source

The retained REST query was `GET repos/tbhb/agent-orchestration-poc/pulls?state=closed&per_page=100&page=<n>`, with the live owner redirected to `tbhb-dev`. The lower bound is `merged_at > 2026-09-26T22:22:57Z` and the upper bound is `merged_at <= 2026-09-27T04:30:06Z`. The query transcript at `research/gates/retro-2026-09-27/evidence/query-transcript.md` records the source time, both requests, projection, and missing fields. `pr-metrics.csv` is the retained sanitized transformation of the per-PR REST details, reviews, files, commits, and Project field snapshot. No later merge enters this population.

## Primary query

DuckDB 1.5.5 reads the committed per-PR table and applies the fixed bounds again. Numeric fields are typed explicitly. The table deliberately leaves the unsettled #84 size and full excluded raw-line fields as `unknown`.

```{python}
#| label: primary-query
import csv
import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

import duckdb

evidence = Path("evidence")
lower = "2026-09-26T22:22:57Z"
upper = "2026-09-27T04:30:06Z"
metric_path = evidence / "pr-metrics.csv"
rows = duckdb.sql(
    """SELECT pr::INTEGER, url, merged_at, declared_size, measured_84_size,
       excluded_raw_lines, excluded_raw_lines_explicit::INTEGER AS excluded_explicit,
       files_changed::INTEGER AS files, changes_requested_rounds::INTEGER AS rounds,
       open_to_merge_seconds::INTEGER AS seconds, updates_from_main, harness, model, effort
       FROM read_csv(?, header=true, all_varchar=true)
       WHERE merged_at > ? AND merged_at <= ? ORDER BY pr::INTEGER""",
    params=[str(metric_path), lower, upper],
).fetchall()
assert len(rows) == 17
assert all(row[4] == row[5] == "unknown" for row in rows)
totals = duckdb.sql(
    """SELECT COUNT(*) AS prs, SUM(rounds) AS rounds, SUM(seconds) AS seconds,
       MEDIAN(seconds) AS median_seconds, SUM(files) AS files,
       SUM(excluded_explicit) AS excluded_explicit,
       SUM(CASE WHEN rounds > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reviewed_changes
       FROM (SELECT changes_requested_rounds::INTEGER AS rounds,
       open_to_merge_seconds::INTEGER AS seconds, files_changed::INTEGER AS files,
       excluded_raw_lines_explicit::INTEGER AS excluded_explicit
       FROM read_csv(?, header=true, all_varchar=true)
       WHERE merged_at > ? AND merged_at <= ?)""",
    params=[str(metric_path), lower, upper],
).fetchone()
assert totals == (17, 12, 51635, 3203.0, 279, 2196, 10)
result_path = evidence / "cohort-results.csv"
with result_path.open("w", newline="") as target:
    writer = csv.writer(target, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(("row_id", "kind", "pr", "rounds", "seconds", "files", "excluded_explicit", "prs", "median_seconds", "reviewed_changes"))
    writer.writerows((f"PR-{row[0]}", "supporting", row[0], row[8], row[9], row[7], row[6], "", "", "") for row in rows)
    writer.writerow(("TOTAL", "headline", "all", totals[1], totals[2], totals[4], totals[5], totals[0], totals[3], totals[6]))
print("Cohort PRs, rounds, seconds, median seconds, files, explicit excluded lines, PRs with changes requested:", totals)
```

## Independent recomputation

Python reads the retained REST listing and each original projected PR, review, and file response separately. This path neither reads the primary result table nor copies its aggregation. It compares every headline and the deterministic ten-row sample selected by SHA-256 of `165|<row_id>`.

```{python}
#| label: independent-check
pages = [json.loads((evidence / f"pulls-page-{page}.json").read_text()) for page in (1, 2)]
assert len(pages[0]) == 49 and pages[1] == []
selected = sorted(
    (item for page in pages for item in page if item["merged_at"] and lower < item["merged_at"] <= upper),
    key=lambda item: item["number"],
)
assert len(selected) == 17
independent = {}
for item in selected:
    number = item["number"]
    detail = json.loads((evidence / f"pr-{number}.json").read_text())
    reviews = json.loads((evidence / f"pr-{number}-reviews.json").read_text())
    files = json.loads((evidence / f"pr-{number}-files.json").read_text())
    seconds = int((datetime.fromisoformat(detail["merged_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00")) - datetime.fromisoformat(detail["created_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))).total_seconds())
    excluded = sum(file["additions"] + file["deletions"] for file in files if file["filename"].startswith(("reports/inputs/", "research/imported/", "tests/fixtures/", "vendor/")) or (file["filename"].startswith("experiments/") and "/evidence/" in file["filename"]) or "/vendor/" in file["filename"] or "-checksum" in file["filename"].split("/")[-1] or file["filename"].endswith(("go.sum", "uv.lock", "pnpm-lock.yaml", ".svg", ".excalidraw")))
    independent[f"PR-{number}"] = (sum(review["state"] == "CHANGES_REQUESTED" and bool(review["submitted_at"]) for review in reviews), seconds, len(files), excluded)
assert [item["number"] for item in selected] == [row[0] for row in rows]
assert sum(value[0] for value in independent.values()) == totals[1]
assert sum(value[1] for value in independent.values()) == totals[2]
assert sorted(value[1] for value in independent.values())[8] == totals[3]
assert sum(value[2] for value in independent.values()) == totals[4]
assert sum(value[3] for value in independent.values()) == totals[5]
assert sum(value[0] > 0 for value in independent.values()) == totals[6]
sample = sorted(independent, key=lambda row_id: (hashlib.sha256(f"165|{row_id}".encode()).hexdigest(), row_id))[:10]
primary = {f"PR-{row[0]}": (row[8], row[9], row[7], row[6]) for row in rows}
for row_id in sample:
    assert independent[row_id] == primary[row_id]
print("Sample row IDs:", ", ".join(sample))
print("Independent headline:", len(selected), *(sum(value[index] for value in independent.values()) for index in range(4)))
```

The independent exclusion expression checks only explicit excluded paths. The complete #84 count would require the unsettled classifier for generated, minified, vendored, fixture, and comment-only changes. These missing fields have no aggregate estimate.
